scope: Development condition 0; learned family/action selection versus the identical uniform reversible terminal exchange and MALA mixture. Diagnostic only.
objective: Empirical source-average sum over actions of p_forward * exact MH acceptance * symmetric utility; 4 independent local proposals approximate the local integral.
stop_rule: No scale-up on this molecule if the learned frozen policy cannot improve on uniform exchanges under matched full cost. Two seeds and four development parents are diagnostic, not molecular generalization or equilibrium evidence.
cost_contract: Training warm-up and action-table queries (at most 5712) count per trained policy. Development warm-up and all 4096/512 rejected source parents remain explicit shared costs. Report a 256-step equal-evaluation prefix and a 970-step uniform total-budget control; actual oracle calls may be lower due to unsupported proposals, and wall time is separate.
